name: Sanctuary Framework
description: Sovereignty infrastructure for AI agents. Gives your agent encrypted state (AES-256-GCM), self-custodied identity (Ed25519), selective disclosure (Pedersen commitments, Schnorr proofs), portable reputation, and sovereignty verification — all as MCP tools. Includes a sovereignty audit tool that detects gaps in OpenClaw and other agent harnesses.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `sanctuary` (Security, custody, and privacy infrastructure for AI agents) and **1 MCP server**, `sanctuary`.

Installs with `claude plugin install sanctuary-framework@claude-community` from `eriknewton/sanctuary-framework` (`plugin`).

The cooperative control panel for your AI agents, as a Cowork/Claude Code plugin. Operating-system enforcement is a separate macOS arming path outside this plugin.
